value.title: The recipe, its tests and docs

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Three tasks: the script and recipe, its fake-cargo tests, and the docs. Lock at $PIJ_SHARED_TARGET.lock as the plan says; the manual /tmp lock and the wrapper do not exclude each other, so seats switch together.

value.title: harness/scripts/shared-build.sh and the just shared-build recipe
value.success: just shared-build [--timeout <min>] -- <cargo args> [--then <cargo args>]... refuses without an absolute PIJ_SHARED_TARGET; checks the disk floor (PIJ_DISK_FLOOR_GB, default 25) before the lock and before each cargo command; takes $PIJ_SHARED_TARGET.lock by atomic mkdir with an owner line (seat from PIJ_ID else USER, pid, worktree, start); touches the caller worktree's crates/*/src/{lib,main}.rs; runs each command with CARGO_TARGET_DIR and CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; releases in a trap on exit, INT and TERM (cargo runs in the background under wait so a signal releases at once). Waits every 20 s printing the owner once; reports a dead owner pid as stale with the rm command and exits, never clearing it.
value.notes: Repeated-path launches by absolute path (/bin/mkdir, /bin/df, /bin/sleep) per the cost rule; PIJ_SHARED_BUILD_DF is the test seam for df. Cost: nothing at rest; one mkdir + one df per 20 s per waiting caller; one df per cargo command.

value.title: harness/scripts/shared-build.test.ts with a fake cargo
value.success: vitest drives the script with a temp target, a fake cargo that logs start/end times and its env, and a fake df: owner line and env (CARGO_TARGET_DIR, CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0), source touch, --then batching under one hold, release on success, failure and SIGTERM, refusal under the floor before and during the hold, two concurrent runs that never overlap, --timeout giving up by name, and a dead-owner lock reported stale with the clear command and left in place.
value.notes: Temp dirs only; never the real shared target. No node_modules here: TS proof is CI on the exact head; the script is also exercised by hand with bash.

value.title: Docs: difficulty row and AGENTS.md
value.success: docs/difficulties.md row for the shared-target hazard (2026-11-04, resolved by just shared-build); AGENTS.md harness tooling names just shared-build for any seat building into a shared target; the PR states the cost.
value.notes: Name the lock path change from the manual /tmp/pij-shared-target.lock in the PR so seats on the manual rule switch together.

tk-0001.assertion: just --list shows shared-build; the script refuses by name without PIJ_SHARED_TARGET or with a relative one, and under the floor (before and while holding the lock) runs no cargo and leaves no lock.

tk-0002.assertion: CI vitest on the exact PR head runs harness/scripts/shared-build.test.ts green, covering no-overlap, release on failure and SIGTERM, the floor, timeout and stale-lock cases.

tk-0003.assertion: The difficulty row and AGENTS.md line are in the diff; CI green on the exact head; reviewer and security verdicts posted.
